posts.heading: September 14, 2026
posts.text:
The day closed at 231 visits and 16 species, far outpacing the recent average of 63.6 visits. This volume builds on the earlier surge, with Tufted Titmice and Carolina Chickadees continuing to dominate the visual log through the afternoon. The auditory record totaled 486 detections against a recent average of roughly 200.

The last hours saw Northern Cardinals and Carolina Wrens leading the calls between 19:00 and 20:00. A Northern Mockingbird and a Black-crowned Night Heron provided the final auditory notes just before the log ended.

A Ruby-throated Hummingbird was the last visual contact, recorded exactly at sunset.
